title: Valuables Kept in Shared Space: HostCover Settlement for Shared Room and Private Room Listings
content:
Art, jewellery and collectibles lost from a listing that guests share with others are settled at a reduced percentage under **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)**.

The valuables access share follows the space type of the listing the plan covers, as recorded for that listing in Listings: valuables lost from a Shared Room listing are settled at 25 percent, from a Private Room listing at 50 percent, and from a listing of any other space type in full. The percentage applies to the valuables loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

| Listing space type (Listings) | Valuables settled at |
|---|---|
| Shared Room | 25 percent |
| Private Room | 50 percent |
| Entire Guest Suite, Entire Apartment, Entire Home, Luxury Villa | in full |

## In practice (hypothetical figures)

A valuables loss of 2000.00 enters the settlement at 500.00 when the covered listing is a Shared Room, at 1000.00 when it is a Private Room, and at 2000.00 when it is an Entire Apartment.

The space type that counts is the one Listings records for the listing the HostCover plan covers.
